title: jasminum sambac var. goaense
intro: Jasminum sambac var. goaense, commonly known as Goa Jasmine or Star Jasmine, is a fragrant and flowering climber native to India. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, including its potential to reduce stress, anxiety, and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Jasminum sambac var. goaense include acting as a sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant contribute to its medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine for treating various health conditions.
